Artifact Library · CLI {{version}} · Linux · macOS · Windows

One executable. No runtime to install.

Publish folders of HTML as versioned artifacts, read what reviewers saved on them, and give your coding agent the skill to do both. Node.js and Bun are not needed at runtime.

8platform builds
{{version}}CLI · API version 1
SHA-256verified by the installers

Install and connect

The installer picks the right build for your system, checks its SHA-256 and puts artifact on your path.

  1. Install on Linux or macOS

    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plugincompany/artifact-library/main/install.sh | sh

    On Windows (PowerShell):

    irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plugincompany/artifact-library/main/install.ps1 | iex

  2. Connect to this server

    artifact config set server http://localhost:3000
artifact doctor

  3. Publish something

    artifact publish ./report --slug q3-report \
  --title "Q3 report" --description "Throughput, quality and staffing." --json

Downloads

Standalone executables from the v{{version}} release. Verify them with SHA256SUMS.

{{downloads}}
PlatformFileSize

Manual install: download your build and SHA256SUMS, run sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing (macOS: shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing), then chmod +x it and move it onto your PATH as artifact.

Give your agent the skill

The skill teaches agents to find, build, publish and update artifacts, and to read the feedback people leave on them.

artifact skill install --agent claude     # Claude Code
artifact skill install --agent opencode   # opencode
artifact skill install --agent codex      # Codex
artifact skill install --path ./skills/artifact-publishing   # anywhere else

Or download the skill: artifact-skill.tar.gz · SKILL.md · deployment.md · building-artifacts.md

Start with the guideAgents should read the artifact guide for agents and copy a page from the reference collection instead of starting from a blank file.

Run your own server

One container. It seeds the agent guide, this page and the reference collection on first start.

docker run -d --name artifact-library \
  -p 3000:3000 -v artifact-data:/data \
  -e PUBLIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 \
  ghcr.io/plugincompany/artifact-library:{{version}}
Before you expose itSet ARTIFACT_TOKEN to require a token for publishing and deleting. Without it, anyone who can reach the server can publish. The -slim image skips server-side previews and is much smaller.

Several libraries

Profiles select independent servers, for example one for work and one for personal projects.

artifact profile add work https://artifacts.example.com
artifact profile add personal http://localhost:3000
artifact profile use work
artifact --profile personal publish ./report --title "Personal report" --json
artifact profile list

Each server has its own artifacts and saved data. The CLI refuses to update a directory tracked to another server; saved retries keep their original destination.

Commands at a glance

--json works everywhere. Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 conflict, 10 newer version available (check).

artifact search "plan" · recent · list --since 7dFind existing work before making something new.
artifact publish ./dir --slug s --title … --description …Create an artifact from a folder.
artifact update s ./dir --message "…"New version at the same link.
artifact feedback s [--since 2h]Everything readers saved: answers, comments, verdicts.
artifact data append s comments.x --item '{"text":"…"}'Reply in a comment thread as the agent.
artifact data set s state.run --file run.jsonUpdate live page state without a new version.
artifact download s --out ./dirGet the original files of any version.
artifact diff s --from 1 --to 3 --textCompare versions.
artifact profile add · list · use · removeManage server endpoints.
artifact doctorCheck the endpoint and API compatibility.
